method_limits: the population is the chain's LEGS table, not every script in scripts/
a face is counted for a leg only when the leg's script names it and it exists on disk
writer reach is judged inside this chain only: a writer run by hand or by another agent is invisible here, so 'no writing mode leg names it' is not 'no writer exists'
age uses the payload's own date field (E453 mtime floor published beside it)
templates are resolved by glob and published with the template text; a template that matches nothing is published as absent rather than counted as stale
title: For every read-only step of the S6 chain: which face does it read, what date does that payload publish, and does any writing-mode step in the same chain reach the same name?
